_national.labelling: Georgian appellations of origin are registered by Sakpatenti (the national IP centre) on application of the National Wine Agency, which controls them. Each specification names the micro-zone, permitted varieties, grape sugar at harvest (in %), max 10 t/ha in most cases, max 650 L wine per tonne, and analytical limits. Processing is usually inside the micro-zone or Kakheti, but bottling may take place anywhere in Georgia; PDO wines are sold in bottles. Qvevri is a traditional method, not a legal category of these PDOs.
_national.sweetness: Georgian specs use: sec (dry) max 4 g/l; demi-sec; naturally demi-doux (semi-sweet) 18 to 45 g/l (Khvanchkara 30 to 45 g/l) by arresting fermentation (by cold and sulphiting), with no added sugar or concentrate; doux (sweet).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: Protected Designations of Origin

ge-akhasheni.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 22% sugar; wine at least 10.5% vol (max 15.6% total), extract at least 22 g/l.
ge-akhasheni.styles: Red naturally semi-sweet (incomplete fermentation, no malolactic).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Akhasheni" specification

ge-atenuri.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 18%; dry wine at least 11%, max 4 g/l; sparkling at least 10.5%.
ge-atenuri.styles: White dry (free-run juice) and sparkling or semi-sparkling (bottle or tank method); grown, made and bottled in the Ateni micro-zone (Kartli).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Atenuri" specification

ge-bolnisi.varieties: White and amber: Rkatsiteli, Chinuri, Goruli Mtsvane. Red: Saperavi, Tavkveri, Shavkapito, Asuretuli Shavi. Rose from coloured varieties.
ge-bolnisi.styles: White, amber, red and rose dry (Kvemo Kartli).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Bolnisi" specification

ge-gurjaani.varieties: Rkatsiteli with up to about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane.
ge-gurjaani.min_alcohol: At least 11%, max 4 g/l, extract at least 16 g/l.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Gurjaani" specification

ge-kakheti.varieties: White and amber: Rkatsiteli, Kakhuri Mtsvane, Kisi, Khikhvi, Mtsvivani Kakhuri, Chitistvala. Red: Saperavi, Saperavi Budeshuri, Cabernet Sauvignon. Rose: Saperavi, Saperavi Budeshuri, Rkatsiteli Rose and others.
ge-kakheti.min_alcohol: Grape sugar at least 20% (dry and semi-dry), 22% (semi-sweet), 24% (sweet).
ge-kakheti.max_yield: Rkatsiteli 12 t/ha; Kakhuri Mtsvane, Kisi, Mtsvivani, Chitistvala 8; Khikhvi 6; Saperavi, Budeshuri, Cabernet 10 t/ha; 650 L/t.
ge-kakheti.styles: Regional PDO: white, amber, red, rose; dry, semi-dry, naturally semi-sweet and sweet.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Kakheti" specification

ge-kardenakhi.varieties: Rkatsiteli with up to about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane and Khikhvi.
ge-kardenakhi.min_alcohol: Amber dry at least 12%, max 4 g/l; white fortified 18% (plus or minus 0.5), sugar max about 10 g/l.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Kardenakhi" specification

ge-khashmis-saperavi.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 20%; wine at least 12%, extract at least 24 g/l, max 4 g/l.
ge-khashmis-saperavi.other: Village of Khashmi (887 ha), Sagarejo, 730 to 800 m; registered 2018; vinified in the micro-zone, bottled anywhere in Georgia.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Saperavi Khashmi" specification

ge-khvanchkara.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 24% sugar; wine at least 11% vol, extract at least 22 g/l, acidity at least 5 g/l.
ge-khvanchkara.styles: Red, naturally semi-sweet (demi-doux) only, by incomplete fermentation on the skins.
ge-khvanchkara.other: Racha (Ambrolauri) micro-zone on the Rioni, about 28 villages incl. Khvanchkara, Tsesi, Chorjo, Sadmeli, plus Alpana and Orbeli (Tsageri); vinification inside the micro-zone, bottling anywhere in Georgia. Registration no. 1 (2005).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Khvanchkara" specification

ge-kindzmarauli.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 22% sugar; wine at least 10.5% vol, extract at least 22 g/l, acidity at least 5 g/l.
ge-kindzmarauli.other: Kvareli micro-zone, 250 to 550 m; processing within Kakheti, bottling anywhere in Georgia. Registered 2006.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Kindzmarauli" specification

ge-kotekhi.other: PDO registered 2007 (no. 799) for the Kotekhi micro-zone on the right bank of the Alazani (250 to 700 m).

ge-mukuzani.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 19% sugar; wine at least 11% (max 15% total), max 4 g/l sugar, extract at least 22 g/l.
ge-mukuzani.ageing: May be released unaged; if aged, at least 6 months in wooden barrels.
ge-mukuzani.other: Right bank of the Alazani, 350 to 700 m. Bottles only.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Mukuzani" specification

ge-napareuli.varieties: White: Rkatsiteli (up to 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane). Red: Saperavi and/or Saperavi Budeshuri.

National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Sviri" specification

ge-teliani.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 19%; wine at least 11% (max 15%), max 4 g/l.
ge-teliani.ageing: If aged, at least 6 months in wooden barrels.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Teliani" specification

ge-tibaani.varieties: Rkatsiteli with up to about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane and Khikhvi.
ge-tibaani.min_alcohol: At least 12%, max 4 g/l, extract at least 22 g/l.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Tibaani" specification

ge-tsinandali.varieties: White: Rkatsiteli at least 85%, Kakhuri Mtsvane max 15%. Red: Saperavi only.
ge-tsinandali.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 19% sugar; wine at least 11% (max 15%), max 4 g/l.
ge-tsinandali.max_yield: 10 t/ha Rkatsiteli and Saperavi, 8 t/ha Kakhuri Mtsvane; 650 L/t.
ge-tsinandali.ageing: May be unaged; if aged, at least 6 months in wooden barrels.
ge-tsinandali.styles: White dry (free-run juice fermented at max 20 C) and red dry.

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Tsinandali" specification

ge-tvishi.styles: White naturally semi-sweet (18 to 45 g/l) and white fortified (Lechkhumi).

src.title: National Wine Agency of Georgia: PDO "Tvishi" specification

ge-vazisubani.varieties: Rkatsiteli with up to about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane.
